title: Team AI training for marketing agencies | Creosote Labs
meta_description: A one-day, hands-on AI workshop for agency account, strategy, and creative staff, run on their own tools and client material. $1,000 per person.
h1: Team AI training for marketing agencies
intro: Account managers, strategists, copywriters, and designers at a marketing agency spend a large part of each week writing: creative briefs, ad copy variations, blog drafts, client status emails, and the commentary in monthly performance reports. Many agencies already have access to an AI tool through Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, or a ChatGPT or Claude subscription, and use of it varies from person to person. Team AI training turns that into a shared, documented practice.

Creosote Labs delivers a one-day workshop, on site or remote, in the AI tool the agency already uses. Participants work on their own computers with live client material: a brief that needs writing, a report that needs commentary, a set of ad variations due this week. Each person finishes the day with a working setup for their role and a written record of their own process. The team receives a written guide, and a 30-day follow-up session is included.
projects: A copywriter builds a reusable setup that drafts ad variations in a client's established voice from past approved copy.
An account manager produces monthly report commentary from a performance export and the agency's report template.
A strategist turns a discovery call transcript into a first-draft creative brief in the agency's format.
A designer drafts alt text, image descriptions, and caption options for a batch of social assets.
The team writes a shared guide covering which client material may be entered into the tool and how outputs are checked before they go to a client.

faqs.a: Training costs $1,000 per person for up to 10 people, with a 5-person minimum. Larger teams are quoted, travel is included, and a program with three monthly follow-up sessions is $1,400 per person.

faqs.q: Which AI tool is the workshop taught in?
faqs.a: The workshop is taught in the tool the agency already uses, whether that is Gemini in Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 Copilot, ChatGPT, or Claude. Participants leave with a setup in the tool they will open the next morning.

faqs.q: Is client work safe to use during the session?
faqs.a: The session uses the agency's own material, and part of the day covers which client material is appropriate to enter into the tool under the agency's client agreements. Anything the agency prefers to hold back can be replaced with past or anonymized work.
